correctness.rationale: The sextic f(x,y)+f(z,w) with f=uv(u^4-v^4) has 6 octahedral root points. The projection/Boissière–Sarti lemma partitions its lines into 36 joining lines and graph lines M=sA, where A permutes the six roots and s^6 c_A=-1. Independently enumerating all 120 image triples gives exactly 24 valid projectivities and 96 excluded by Gaussian norm gcds 50, 3200 or 204800, supported only at primes 2 and 5; this excludes new projectivities for every p>=7. Exact multiplier and normalized scalar conditions place all lines in Q(zeta24), and a primitive-zeta24 graph forces minimality. Cyclotomic Frobenius yields the eight classes mod24; independently counted PGL2(Fp) projectivities and graph scalars for p=7,11,13,17,19,23,29,31 and special p5, reproducing [180,60,40,24,108,84,40,24] modulo24 and 156 rational lines at p5. At p5 the six zeros become P1(F5), projective stabilizer jumps to PGL2(F5) of order120, giving 36+720=756 geometric lines. For p>=7 smoothness follows from the vanishing gradient discriminant (only p|24 can create nontrivial common critical pair).
residual_risks: Completeness uses the standard separated-variable lines lemma plus exact finite stabilizer certificate; direct finite-field tests corroborate but do not prove all p.
